content_of_post_to_comment: This is a question for Christians. I’m curious, do you forgive people, love people, value people and volunteer in your community because it’s what Jesus and the Bible says to do? Or because it’s the right thing to do?
comment: I wonder if the deeper test is what happens when doing the right thing costs us something. Faith can give us a reason to begin, but what sustains compassion when there's no reward or recognition?
